result:
The moment I held my newly born daughter in my arms, a wave of emotions crashed over me, leaving me in a state of awe and profound amazement. Her tiny fingers and toes, each precisely forming and already evoking an instinctual response: scratching where her nails grow, and sucking her fingers as if the world inside her womb was quite literally her first pacifier. On that first morning after her birth, I found myself gazing at her in utter admiration, finding comfort in the monotone balm of predictability that cradled her gaze, the occasional blinks that accompanied her piercing eyes. Roughly within the first hour of her life, these seemingly innate reflexes presented themselves: her mouth opened at the touch of something, her palm digits clutching to my hand with an earnest impersonation of knowledge, her grip tenacity overcoming any minimal pressure I applied. The tranquility enfolding our hearts had the palpability of still waters mingling with the syncopated rhythms of her breathing. Each and every day thereafter has been an exploration into this vast ocean of unforeseen emotions - our lives now entwined forever.

First and foremost, every passing day revealed to us the power of love. Love, it seems, comes in many forms but is a force intensified and magnified through the mere presence of a newborn. It bombards you, fiercely permeating every pore, demanding your undivided attention. It demands you to discard everything possibly competing or surpassing this supercharged state of adoration and absolute concern. It vies for your soul, fighting against the ever-hopeful notion that you can allocate sufficient attention to an array of affairs, whether mundane or otherwise. Truth dictates that one husband does not factor into the equation, nor do the residue desires, wants, duties, tasks, or even Tom Hardy's DVD collection. Your career, in essence, regresses into an evolving game of ping-pong, struggling to find sufficient respite to soak in the newly kindled dreams now a cosmic interjection in your reality, dreams that replace a scattered residue of past aspirations and wavering ambitions. Yet, when you whisper 'goodnight' within the gentle embrace of her soft, dewy cheeks enveloped by her velvety-silken dark hair, it becomes less about inhibition and more about sublimation – a state where quietly surrendering to the profound transformation of your being, becomes a complex balance of equilibrium.

Not longer than a handful of minutes passed since the introduction of these newfound symphonics, the delicate transition from new-found love, to an intense milestone of intimidation, ensued. The demarcation of a lifetime between a family member and a fathomless undefined abyss rests solely in anticipation, surreptitious hopes, and continual incremental conquests presided over by our previously primordial instincts. The causes for this fine line should no longer evade logic or explanation. The farce, if I dare say it, must reasonably derive from the emergence of an entity far beyond your unbiased, undeviating idealism. What Mother nature demands, usually, is a covenant of conceivable aptitude. Whether a teacup could withstand the immense weight displacement of a crystal goblet, tragedies and expectations ensue beneath arms furnished fulfilment of basic expectations, yet undeniably crushed by inconceivable whimpers - crushed by false expectations and the crushing of losses along the road of joy. Cursed by an incessant riddle by the very evolutionary orders seeking perfection in conditions where evolution champions perseverance, hardly making an appearance in the eye of the storm caused by injurious emergencies, pertinent in the realm of the scientific exploration, yet ceaselessly neglecting the intricate nuances and complex trial-and-error sequences of surviving.

Now, when we converse and she listens intently to the intricately woven words emitted from our lips, a new language enters discussion - a novel, invisible dialect where one's intentions are felt, not merely heard. The subtle sweetness and curt bitterness that I'd previously struggled to articulate, transform into impressionable imprints upon her tenderly malleable intellect. Instinctively, her comprehension of language is synchronized with her own heavenly pace. Once you have stumbled upon this vertebrate inherent instinct to connect, those yet to emerge its torchbearer are perched on the cusp of illimitable enlightenment.

The enjoyment of newborns is enigmatic; a paradox that can only be appreciated while journeying unrestricted towards their whimsical existence. Their hysterical insights and the abrupt yet invigorating hiccups of life bring a sense of anosognosia that is, for some, bypassing the art of denial. Accepting failure and patience with less-than-perfect moments has replaced former pursuits of disseminating Sartre's work. Instead, immediate gratification often manifests itself within the tender cradle of a newborn's smile or through the jagged grin upon the advent of a belly-aching fit. These zealous thirst for every soothing yet erratic instance of recognition is welcomed by the eyes of nascent worldlings. The dreams that once inflamed our souls, slowly diminished away to gentle whispers of fond memories, shrouded in the golden haze of reminisces.

Perhaps humility should have been the main guidepost. With the tireless endeavour killed, it beckons to preceding engagements and passions longed for whilst fantastically pondering about an alternative cosmos, home to unrequited consumer ambitions and fashion goals anterior to time. One realizes that life, however, is subject to abrupt transformation, serving as a testament that perhaps flaunting a congenital predisposition in the sublime and the product of evolution, passion shared between the bonded heartbeats, and emotional transcendence, shouldn't all hinge on the acquisition of the tangible patina of success. Rather, it is the innumerable words, infused with earnest humility intertwined with sublime overflows of selfless indulgences, accolades and ventures turned virtuous that embody the unyielding tranquility of your leave.

On this note, a single-hearted advice: forego all desire to ever strip bare the tender veil that intertwines your loved ones. Embrace the gift of a life aflutter with new experiences and insights carried by youthful enthusiasm. Embody the truth in the matter - fear of loss can never ever redeem but only escalate, while joy can be cultivated but never ensnared. They are but seasonal passages, singing an admirable melody over eternally important notes. Embrace the present moment, what could be delivered forth is not worth endeavoring to encapsulate.
